work.permit: Autorizim paraprak i Inspektoratit të Punës

note: Read in the texts WIPO Lex holds. Majority: Civil Code (Law No. 7850 of 29.7.1994, as amended to Law No. 113/2016), Article 6: full capacity to acquire rights and take on civil obligations arises on turning 18; a woman who marries before 18 gains full capacity by marriage, which the form doesn't hold, and a minor from 14 acts only with a parent's or guardian's prior consent (Article 7). Work: Labour Code (Law No. 7961 of 12.7.1995, as amended to Law No. 136/2015 of 5.12.2015), Article 98: employing children under 16 is prohibited; from 15 to 16 only light work in school holidays (Article 99) or vocational training; children under 15, or in full-time compulsory schooling, may be employed in cultural, artistic, sporting or advertising activity (Article 102) only with the Labour Inspectorate's prior authorisation, case by case, under a Council of Ministers decision on conditions and procedure, which wasn't read. No lower age is set. Amendments after 2015 weren't looked for. Service: not read. The Ministry of Defence's pages (mod.gov.al) recruit active soldiers by application and selection, which reads as no call-up, but no page or law found today says the army asks no compulsory service, so service is left null.

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Kodi Civil i Republikës së Shqipërisë (Law No. 7850/1994, amended up to Law No. 113/2016)
sources.said: Personit, kur mbush moshën tetëmbëdhjetë vjeç, i lind zotësia e plotë që me veprimet e tij të fitojë të drejta dhe të marrë përsipër detyrime civile.

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Kodi i Punës i Republikës së Shqipërisë (Law No. 7961/1995, amended up to Law No. 136/2015)
sources.said: 1. Ndalohet marrja në punë e fëmijëve nën moshën 16 vjeç. ... 1. Fëmijët nën moshën 15 vjeç ose fëmijët, të cilët janë duke ndjekur arsimin e detyrueshëm me kohë të plotë mund të punësohen për qëllime të ushtrimit të veprimtarive kulturore, artistike, sportive ose reklamuese vetëm nëse plotësohen njëkohësisht këto kushte ... b) Inspektorati i Punës jep autorizim paraprak rast pas rasti.
